selected_obligation: Reconcile historical Project-Frankenstein FrankEye/Digital-Retina vision pipeline and Drive Frank.ink visual pipeline evidence against the current FRANK 0.1 adaptive Micro Visual Classifier requirement.

source_refs.observed_claim: FrankEye unified vision module merges Digital Retina v8 CNN classifier, DINOv2 scene analysis, GOLPU feature extraction, Tesseract OCR and OpenCV face detection into a fast CPU-only pipeline producing natural-language image descriptions. It declares fast/deep modes and CPU-only guards.

Ground-truth self-knowledge entry frankeye_vision describes FrankEye as 100% local Retina v8 CNN + GOLPU features + OCR/pytesseract + face recognition, CPU-only, no VLM, broad image-format support. This is feature self-knowledge training evidence, not an adaptive visual learner implementation.

source_refs.observed_claim: Frank.ink public/drive text reports a visual pipeline OCR -> YOLOv8n INT8 -> CLIP-B/32 INT8 -> DINOv2 -> VLM-style narrative, p50 about 900 ms on 1 vCPU and about 95% concept recall on an internal benchmark. This is measurement/architecture evidence for a related but non-identical Frank.ink lineage.

FRANK 0.1 requires an adaptive Micro Visual Classifier with reusable frozen visual features, calibrated confidence/open-set gate, bounded cyclic updates, trusted example tiers, shadow evaluation, promotion/rollback and resource instrumentation.

Recommended implementation ladder is MVC-0 prototype memory, MVC-1 frozen-backbone linear classifier, MVC-2 tiny MLP only if benchmarks justify it, with confidence != truth and familiarity != evidence.

findings.summary: Project-Frankenstein contains a concrete historical FrankEye vision pipeline with Digital Retina v8 CNN, DINOv2, GOLPU, OCR and face detection. It is a strong feature-backbone/pipeline inheritance source for FRANK 0.1 Retina/MVC work.

Drive/IAR Frank.ink visual pipeline evidence uses OCR/YOLOv8n/CLIP/DINOv2/VLM-style narrative and reports p50/recall metrics. This is related to but not byte/architecture-identical with Project-Frankenstein FrankEye, which uses Retina v8/GOLPU/DINOv2/OCR and explicitly says no VLM in self-knowledge training. Treat as cross-lineage divergence requiring reconciliation, not duplicate closure.

No evidence in the read Project-Frankenstein/Drive surfaces shows the full FRANK 0.1 adaptive MVC contract already implemented: no versioned prototype/classifier state, trusted GOLD/SILVER/BRONZE admission, candidate-vs-current shadow evaluation, rollback, open-set calibrated MVC states or bounded cyclic update loop were verified in this shard. Therefore historical FrankEye must not be counted as H1 adaptive visual learner PASS.

Reusable inheritance candidates: CPU-only runtime guards, modular fast/deep visual pipeline split, OCR + local feature extraction, DINO/GOLPU/Retina feature surfaces, broad-image preprocessing, and natural-language perception-context output. These should become feature-backbone and perception-front-end candidates for MVC-E1/E2/E6, not semantic authority.

retina.delta: Historical FrankEye is a concrete local visual pipeline to preserve as lineage. Use it as baseline/front-end candidate, but append MVC state/update/open-set/rollback semantics rather than treating it as already adaptive.

frank.delta: FRANK architecture should inherit FrankEye-style local perception surfaces while enforcing the fixed FRANK 0.1 law: micro-classifier prediction != sensor truth; familiarity != evidence; confidence != authority.

claycode.delta: ClayCode must express not only image description calls but versioned MVC state transitions: buffer admission, prototype/readout update, confidence/open-set outcome, promotion/rejection/rollback, feature-version migration and replay hooks.

claygraph.delta: ClayGraph should store learned visual entity/prototype lineage as provenance-linked familiarity nodes, not observed-truth nodes.

unifieddb.delta: UnifiedDB must persist classifier/prototype version identity, training evidence tiers, calibration metadata, feature-backbone compatibility and rollback/rebuild state.

harness.delta: H1 tests must distinguish historical FrankEye perception from MVC learning; pass requires MVC-E1..E7 style evidence, not only local OCR/CNN/DINO/GOLPU inference.

gwt.delta: MVC output is a routing/familiarity candidate for workspace broadcast, not a broadcast-level truth source. Unknown/ambiguous/conflict states should increase sensing/retina escalation.

emergenz.delta: Emergence measurements should test routing/compute savings and lesion-rescue of the MVC layer separately from base Retina perception.

hyperposition.delta: Represent known/unknown/ambiguous/conflict visual hypotheses as set-valued alternatives until confidence/open-set and sensor evidence justify narrowing.
